source: live Spark startup and post-request telemetry from first-three bring-up on 2026-06-06, 2026-06-06 DSV4 16-way steady-state memory probe before layer rebalance, 2026-06-07 first3 startup fit check, 2026-06-07 all-three resident telemetry showing spark2/spark4/spark5 host RAM pressure, 2026-06-07 Qwen-last startup OOM at the 0.30/0.30/0.18 cap mix, and partition-fingerprinted external cache roots for the rebalance

resident_batch_token_budget.notes: Qwen 65536 at 0.25 produced negative KV headroom on all ranks during first3 startup, so the Qwen token budget stays at 32768 while using the lower 0.25 resident cap. Gemma 24576 at 0.25 failed cache-block allocation in the triple-resident fit check, and the 2026-06-07 Qwen-last relaunch failed CUDA memory snapshot with Gemma at 0.30, so Gemma returns to the measured 0.20 cap used by the stronger 15/17 COMPSEC validation profile. DSV4 now uses the same 32768 short-context token budget as Qwen while retaining a fixed 2GiB KV cap, which is the smallest deployed cap above the observed 1.92GiB requirement for the 262144 max model length startup check; admit long prompts by token budget rather than pretending every 64-way cohort can carry large contexts.

coordinator.notes: First-three resident feed settings keep Qwen/Gemma saturated while DSV4 uses the 64-way short-context service-level batch limit from the DSV4 production profile.

gemma4_26b_a4b_pp8.notes: Live all-three resident startup left spark4 under the 12 GiB floor. Moving one Gemma layer from spark4 to spark7 preserves Gemma max stage depth at 4 while restoring the 12 GiB floor. Qwen/Gemma LMCache local CPU tiers are capped at 1 GiB per rank so the external cache grows on NVMe, not host RAM.

projection.notes: Conservative floor uses live all-three resident telemetry from 2026-06-07 plus observed DSV4/Qwen/Gemma per-rank load deltas. The layer rebalance moves combined stage count from 14/17/17/17/19/19/19/15 to 14/17/15/20/17/18/19/17, shifting work from spark2/spark4/spark5 toward spark3/spark7 while keeping max combined stage count at the prior 20-layer ceiling. The 0.25/0.20/0.18 cap mix is required for Qwen-last startup after DSV4+Gemma residency; replace this projection with post-cap telemetry after deploy.
